name: Yuganda Yokubou - Netorase Tsuma Shelly
original_name: 歪んだ欲望　寝取らせ妻シェリー
source:
Eddy was the proprietor of a run-down tavern living a boring life. That was until he met an adventurer named Shelly. One thing led to another, and the two tied the knot.

She was a total beauty, with great proportions to boot. Surely, Eddy was the happiest man in the world...

Yet deep down, a dark, warped desire dwelled within Eddy. And that happy life would soon come crashing down...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ362528.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
埃迪开着一家破败的酒馆，过着乏味的日子。直到有一天，他遇见一位名叫雪莉的冒险者。两人一步步走到了一起，最后结为夫妻。

雪莉是个十足的美人，身材也无可挑剔。埃迪理当是世上最幸福的人…

可是，在他的心底潜藏着一种阴暗、扭曲的欲望。那份幸福的生活，也即将轰然崩塌…
